name: FrenchModelVariant681_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/image60348_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (rings, echoes and bursts); for a non-negative request it packs three textures from the image table and sets up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-image60348-entry.md)

HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
